name: Kayama Mika
source:
A girl who is a cousin and childhood friend of Yoshiaki. Though she has feelings for Yoshiaki, she can't confess to him. She can't go along with the women of the Kagura family. She becomes the protagonist's first victim but,  because he has the same face as Yoshiaki, she mistakes one for another and stays confused for some time.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070827142514/http://www.assemblage.co.jp/asm/carmine/noise/noise_char.html]official site, archived[/url]]
